test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question: A cylinder has a radius of (8)/(π) cm and its volume is 448 cm³ . What is the height of the cylinder (take π = (22)/(7))?
solution:
**Given:**

A cylinder has a radius of (8)/(π) cm and its volume is 448 cm3 .

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cylinder = π r²h

**Calculation:**

According to the question, 

448 = π (8/π)² h

⇒ h = (448 × 22)/(64 × 7) 

⇒ 22 cm

**∴ The height of the cylinder is 22 cm.**
